TOMIE.paper_facts_compact: The paper reports 112,860 RGB frames and 640,936 instances from six warehouse cameras, including Euro/CHEP/hygiene pallets. It derives projected boxes from pose and explicitly lacks visual other-entity occlusion information. Its Visible flag concerns camera field of view; fully hidden objects can retain boxes. Raised viewpoints and synchronisation limitations need checking.

annotation_code_evidence.inspection: Converter emits categories and bbox; no keypoints/segmentation export found in inspected code. This is code-level evidence only; raw ZIP annotation schema was not deserialized.

documented_annotations.Occlusion_column: Exists in code header; cannot be assumed visual foreign-object/cue blockage. Its raw-record semantics require audit.

TOMIE.physical_relevance: Actual published figures show ordinary low-profile wooden and perforated hygiene-type pallets plus natural loads/clutter. They are a closer object-shape match than block-only imagery, but usefulness of tiny structural cues in unmarked raw views is not yet established.
TOMIE.fixed_q_D_vs_E_relevance: Potential additional appearance and natural-occlusion RGB. It requires target identity and a particular physically grounded local cue, an unchanged query/crop, and uncertainty-aware visible/foreign-cover annotation. Neither AABB corners nor entity bbox presence establish that cue.
TOMIE.native_association: UNKNOWN; arbitrary AABB or projected model corners must not be promoted to native8/human D/E truth.
